included_changes: Existing 0.4.2 redesign and generation fixes from candidate A.
Post-candidate source fixes for reception image selection, progress feedback and safe diagnostics.
Reviewed merchant-voice prompts, revision invalidation, translation cache identity and builtin-rule v2 adoption.
Conservative recovery for proven-unsent obsolete WhatsApp batches without resetting attempts or clearing receipt evidence.

build.commit_precheck_correction: The post-build documentation writer emitted CRLF, which git diff --check rejected. Generated documentation and records were normalized to LF and the explicit 22-file source set was committed before candidate validation. No rebuild or intervening candidate validation was run.

frozen_backend.bytecode_method: Read the executable embedded PYZ archive and recursively compare bytecode operands, names and constants with compiled current source; do not execute application modules.
frozen_backend.scope: Synthetic account databases, loopback HTTP and embedded bytecode inspection; no real model naturalness or real merchant ledger replay.

observations: Two narrow-window screenshots contain a dismissible saved-range notice over part of a disabled save button or policy heading. Static images do not establish a persistent obstruction; no extra product change was made.
candidate_windows.scope: Actual isolated Electron and owned system Chrome windows with synthetic customers. Workbench uses candidate renderer/preload with source synthetic business support; launcher uses candidate SDK, extension and frozen account backend. This is not a new exhaustive design comparison or a real merchant acceptance test.

independent_exe_entry.reason: The earlier candidate A entry exited before opening a window while installed user processes remained. This round preserved those processes and used isolated candidate-resource window probes; B independent entry is not claimed passed.

publication.metadata_source: public GitHub HTML redirects; unauthenticated API was rate limited

initial_check_failures: The build itself succeeded. A post-build documentation newline check failed before commit; corrected to LF and committed without another build.

The update verifier initially compared a lowercase drive path against delivery's uppercase drive path; using the exact absolute candidate path passed. Original diagnostic: artifacts/verification/publish-042-B-20261117/update-initial-failure.txt.

The first unknown-backup probe label collided with an older 0.4.1 report directory and stopped at mkdir before spawning a backend. A fresh release-042-b-20261117-001 label passed; the historical report was not overwritten or counted.
